newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X to resume on Toronto on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X to resume on Toronto on Thursday.

text.p: Shares in Canadian gold prospector Bre-X Minerals Ltd will resume trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Thursday, the exchange said in a statement.
Bre-X's stock stopped trading on the TSE on Wednesday due to a heavy volume of orders and technical problems with the exchange's computer trading system.
The stock fell 0.65 to 3.20 on turnover of 11.7 million shares before trading was stopped at 1110 EST/1610 GMT.
The Toronto exchange said trading will resume in Bre-X shares at 0930 EST/1430 GMT on Thursday.

Shares in the Calgary, Alberta-based firm have traded for just over two hours on Canada's biggest equity market since investors lopped almost C$3 billion ($2.19 billion) off Bre-X's market value last Thursday.
The stock has been hit by concerns about the size and viability of Bre-X's Busang gold discovery in Indonesia.
